summary: Research the request, implement an accepted solution, independently review it, and obtain human approval.

nodes.title: Research requirements and existing behavior
nodes.description: Inspect relevant evidence, identify constraints, and resolve or record open questions before implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Requirements and supporting evidence are recorded.
Unresolved questions and risks are explicit.

nodes.title: Implement and verify the solution
nodes.description: Make changes supported by research and verify the user's acceptance conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Relevant tests pass and verification evidence is recorded.

nodes.title: Independently review implementation and evidence
nodes.description: Check correctness, safety, requirements coverage, and test evidence independently of implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Review findings are recorded and blocking findings are resolved.

nodes.title: Obtain explicit human approval
nodes.description: Present results and review evidence to the human; never infer approval from completed work.
acceptance_criteria: An authorized human explicitly approves the reviewed result.
